title: The Chaldean Oracles, Vol. 2
author: G. R. S. Mead
description: The Chaldean Oracles, Volume 2, by G. R. S. Mead (London: Theosophical Publishing Society, 1908), Volume IX of the 'Echoes from the Gnosis' series, completing his presentation of the surviving fragments of the second-century theurgic poem revered by the later Neoplatonists. This volume covers fragments on the soul and its descent into the body, the body and its vehicles, the daemons and the material realm, fate and providence, the nature of evil, and above all the means of the soul's purification and ascent: theurgic rites, the fire of the soul, the 'vehicle' (ochema), the virtues and the mystical union with the divine. Mead's commentary links the Oracles to Platonism, Gnosticism, Mithraism and Hermeticism. With Volume 1, it is one of the best introductions for esoteric readers to this foundational text of theurgy.
